methodology: Four seeds, two pricing modes, idle/managed, four fiscal arms: 64 revision 1 worlds + 16 untouched revision 0 pooled/itinerary controls. Merchant charter, Ascension 0, Sandbox, 365 days. All new arms share revision 1 finite initial imports and Coverage floor. Each fiscal arm is compared with revision 1 None, holding buffers and the target floor fixed. None versus historical controls measures the buffer/floor package; Combined versus historical controls measures the full revision effect. The submitted seed shares geography and roles with the read-only fixture, not its Industrial/A1 charter or unknown command history. Fixed managed policy copies the previously documented circulation Farm/Mill/Bakery/Lumber investments, stock/cash controls and physical Flour/Logs shipping. No Mint, external contracts, fabricated inventory/cash, per-seed rescue or outcome-driven tuning. All numeric goods/coins are raw 1/10,000; prices are coins per whole good. Quotes are hypothetical current-state player proposals, not permission to trade remotely. Checkpoints retain actual state only; no terminal fixture is advanced. Runtime is printed only. Positive company reference value and food consumed are not proof of universal or perpetual sustainability.
managedPolicy: At day 0 pay for food-source Farm, processor Mill, recovery Bakery and recovery Lumber Camp. Farm sells Grain; Mill buys Grain (maximum 24 coins) and sells Flour (minimum 6 coins) using existing Mill policy. Recovery Bakery buys Logs (target 3, maximum 18 coins), sells Bread (minimum 1 coin); Camp sells Logs (minimum 1 coin); industry cash reserves 100 coins except unchanged Mill 80. Enable each facility only with company cash >= 120 coins and public output stock below Grain 24 / Flour 12 / Bread 24 / Logs 12 respectively. Sail the initially empty Merchant ship to processor; apply one real Flour/Logs industrial route. Buy up to 4 Flour (minimum 1, maximum 22 coins), physically unload to recovery warehouse; buy up to 8 Logs (minimum 1, maximum 12 coins) there and sell at processor (minimum 1 coin). Route reserve 100 coins, empty returns allowed. No other ships, goods, direct stock assignments or cash interventions. The same unretuned policy can stall; checkpoints report that outcome.
